update: set -euo pipefail; v="{versions}"; pick() { jq -er --arg k "$1" '.[$k]' "$v"; }; react=$(pick @lynx-js/react); rspeedy=$(pick @lynx-js/rspeedy); plugin=$(pick @lynx-js/react-rsbuild-plugin); webcore=$(pick @lynx-js/web-core); webelements=$(pick @lynx-js/web-elements); android=$(pick lynx-android); ios=$(pick lynx-ios); for dir in . tier; do (cd "$dir" && npm install --save-exact --no-audit --no-fund "@lynx-js/react@$react" && npm install --save-exact --save-dev --no-audit --no-fund "@lynx-js/rspeedy@$rspeedy" "@lynx-js/react-rsbuild-plugin@$plugin" "@lynx-js/web-core@$webcore" "@lynx-js/web-elements@$webelements"); done; sed -i.bak -E "s/^lynxVersion=.*/lynxVersion=$android/" android/gradle.properties && rm android/gradle.properties.bak; sed -i.bak -E "s/^LYNX_VERSION = '.*'/LYNX_VERSION = '$ios'/" ios/Podfile && rm ios/Podfile.bak; export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; (cd ios && pod install --repo-update); jq --tab --arg version "$android" '.version = $version' arena.json > arena.json.tmp && mv arena.json.tmp arena.json

ios.build: set -euo pipefail; [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline; npx rspeedy build --environment lynx; export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; (cd ios && pod install); xcodebuild -workspace ios/ArenaLynx.xcworkspace -scheme ArenaLynx -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES ARCHS=arm64 -quiet build; xcodebuild -workspace ios/ArenaLynx.xcworkspace -scheme ArenaLynx -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet build

android.build: set -euo pipefail; [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline; npx rspeedy build --environment lynx; export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home}" ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}"; cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --max-workers=4

web.build: set -euo pipefail; [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline; npx rspeedy build --environment web; node web/assemble.ts

android.build: set -euo pipefail; cd "{project}"; [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline; npx rspeedy build --environment lynx; host="$(dirname "{versions}")/apps/lynx"; export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home}" ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}"; "$host/android/gradlew" -p "$host/android" assembleRelease --max-workers=4 -ParenaBundle="{project}/dist/main.lynx.bundle" -ParenaApplicationId=dev.leptoskit.arena.lynx.tier -ParenaBuildDir="$host/android/build/tier"; mkdir -p "{project}/build" && cp "$host/android/build/tier/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk" "{project}/build/app-release.apk"

ios.build: set -euo pipefail; cd "{project}"; [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline; npx rspeedy build --environment lynx; host="$(dirname "{versions}")/apps/lynx"; export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; (cd "$host/ios" && pod install); xcodebuild -workspace "$host/ios/ArenaLynx.xcworkspace" -scheme ArenaLynx -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath "$host/ios/build/DerivedData" SYMROOT="$host/ios/build/tier" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARENA_LYNX_BUNDLE="{project}/dist/main.lynx.bundle" ARENA_BUNDLE_ID=dev.leptoskit.arena.lynx.tier -quiet build; rm -rf "{project}/build/ios" && mkdir -p "{project}/build/ios" && cp -R "$host/ios/build/tier/Release-iphoneos/ArenaLynx.app" "{project}/build/ios/"

web.build: set -euo pipefail; cd "{project}"; [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline; npx rspeedy build --environment web; host="$(dirname "{versions}")/apps/lynx"; node "$host/web/assemble.ts" "{project}"

absent.macos: Lynx 4.2 ships its macOS SDK as a CMake archive with no app template; the arena has no host for it yet
absent.windows: Lynx 4.2 ships its Windows SDK as a CMake archive with no app template; the arena has no host for it yet
